edits.value_json: 四 means “four.” Early forms written 亖 are described as directly representing four and coexisted with forms written 四; the counting-rod account is a separate interpretation of some 四 forms. The present visible layout is enclosing 囗 around inner 儿-form strokes. Competing proposals say 四 was a breath-related graph linked to 呬, later borrowed for “four,” or the original graph for 泗 (“nasal discharge”), later borrowed for “four”; the breath referent’s ancient name is unknown, and the 泗 proposal lacks textual attestation.
